user.title: Choose a fan
user.description: Fans found over Bluetooth. Close the Fan Smart Sync phone app first, because the fan only accepts one connection at a time.

confirm.title: Add this fan?
confirm.description: Found {name}. Close the Fan Smart Sync phone app first, because the fan only accepts one connection at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't read the fan. Close the phone app, check that the fan has power, and try again.

abort.already_configured: This fan is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No fans found over Bluetooth. Check that the fan has power and is in range of Home Assistant's Bluetooth adapter or a Bluetooth proxy.
